vibe_rationale: Invitation-only pre-1990s single-fin contest with a deep surf community and an all-day hang, but a narrow single scene with no wider programming.
fit_notes: Strong Australian surf crossover, with Joel Parkinson and Laura Enever on the 2026 listing, and Australians were the largest source of Bali arrivals in 2025 (23.44 per cent, BPS Bali). A recovery or hydration role at the all-day beach hang could suit, but this is a culture play with small reach.
